purpose: Coordinate disposable parallel chats without making the human a message bus and without turning coordination into product authority.
principles: Workers write independent status objects; NETWORK is derived and read-only.
EPOCH is the cheap freshness check. Same epoch means no coordination reread is required.
Only material cross-workstream discoveries propagate; local implementation detail remains in Git/RETURN.
Disjoint write scopes proceed in parallel. Collisions and dependency changes are surfaced only to affected workstreams.
No heartbeat loops or global distributed locks by default.
Public coordination metadata never contains LOCAL/private Capture, Patent, transcript, credential or secret content.
Network/worker state coordinates work only; it never grants Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.

fields.worker_instance_id: Disposable id for one chat/agent instance.
fields.branch: Current branch when material writes exist.
fields.frontier: Small description of the next unsatisfied execution frontier.
fields.last_useful_delta: What useful thing now exists that did not before; never a transcript dump.
fields.write_scope: Paths this worker is currently authorized/scoped to modify.
fields.depends_on: Workstream/capability dependencies whose changes may alter execution.
fields.impacts: Workstream ids/topics that should be reconsidered if last_useful_delta is reusable.
fields.candidate_shared_owners: Shared capability owner candidates discovered locally.
fields.epoch_seen: Last public EPOCH id loaded by this worker.
fields.reported_head: Optional head for external repositories or environments the compiler cannot inspect directly.

worker_status.write_rule: Update only on material frontier/change/handoff; no periodic heartbeat requirement.

convergence.rule: Emit events instead of globally locking workers; only HARD_WRITE_COLLISION blocks overlapping material writes until reconciled.

epoch.same_epoch: Continue current packet/frontier without reading NETWORK or DELTA again.
epoch.new_epoch: Load only the freshly compiled packet for the active workstream; the packet already filters relevant network changes.
